currentOnly.name: TestDirectoryStore_InterruptedSavePreservesPriorSnapshotAndSuccessfulSaveReplacesIt
currentOnly.behavior: An interrupted directory save preserves the prior snapshot, while a later successful save replaces it atomically.

currentOnly.name: TestCompactPetriTokenHistory_BoundsFiveHundredAndOneThousandLargeTerminalLifecycles
currentOnly.behavior: Compaction bounds durable history for 500- and 1,000-lifecycle large terminal workloads.

currentOnly.name: TestCompactPetriTokenHistory_PreservesReachableAndRetiresConsumedTerminalHistory
currentOnly.behavior: Compaction retains reachable Petri-token history and retires consumed terminal history.

currentOnly.name: TestDurablePetriFailureHistorySnapshotGrowthIsBounded
currentOnly.behavior: Durable Petri failure-history snapshot growth remains bounded as terminal history accumulates.

currentOnly.name: TestJavaScriptRuntimeService_CloseCancelsJoinsAndPersistsAsyncSession
currentOnly.behavior: Close cancels the asynchronous session, joins its worker, and persists the resulting session state.

currentOnly.name: TestJavaScriptRuntimeService_CloseRejectsResumeWithoutOrphaningSession
currentOnly.behavior: Close rejects a resume request without orphaning the interrupted session or its reservation.

currentOnly.name: TestJavaScriptRuntimeService_CloseRejectsStartWithoutOrphaningReservation
currentOnly.behavior: Close rejects a new start without orphaning the admission reservation or leaving a stranded session.

currentOnly.name: TestJavaScriptRuntimeService_CloseReportsNonCooperativeRunTimeout
currentOnly.behavior: Close reports the configured non-cooperative run timeout while preserving the running session's terminal and cleanup semantics.

currentOnly.name: TestJavaScriptRuntimeService_OversizedPetriSnapshotKeepsPriorSessionAvailable
currentOnly.behavior: An oversized Petri snapshot fails closed while the prior durable session remains available.

currentOnly.name: TestJavaScriptRuntimeService_SnapshotSizeLimitHonorsExactBoundAndRejectsBeforeSave
currentOnly.behavior: The exact snapshot-size boundary is enforced before save, with oversized content rejected without publishing a replacement.

currentOnly.name: TestLegacyInterruptedSnapshot_RemainsLosslessOnSuccessfulSave
currentOnly.behavior: A legacy interrupted snapshot remains lossless when successfully saved into the current representation.

currentOnly.name: TestLegacyTerminalSnapshot_MigratesOnNextSuccessfulSaveAndReload
currentOnly.behavior: A legacy terminal snapshot migrates on the next successful save and reloads through the current durable representation.

currentOnly.name: TestPersistSessionSnapshotWarningDoesNotHideSaveFailure
currentOnly.behavior: A snapshot warning does not mask the underlying save failure or change its authoritative outcome.

currentOnly.name: TestPersistSessionSnapshotWarnsBeforeConfiguredHardLimit
currentOnly.behavior: Snapshot persistence emits its warning before the configured hard limit is reached.

currentOnly.name: TestPersistedTokenFailureHistoryRetainsHeadTailAndReloads
currentOnly.behavior: Persisted token-failure history retains its bounded head and tail and reloads the same history.

currentOnly.name: TestPersistedTokenFailureHistoryWithinCapacityIsUnchanged
currentOnly.behavior: Failure history at or below capacity remains unchanged rather than being compacted unnecessarily.

currentOnly.name: TestPetriTokenSummary_RoundTripsThroughTaggedDurableHistory
currentOnly.behavior: The Petri-token summary round-trips through tagged durable history without losing its typed representation.

currentOnly.name: TestRecordPetriTokenMutations_CompactsCandidateAndPublishesOnlyAfterSave
currentOnly.behavior: Candidate Petri-token mutations are compacted and become observable only after durable save succeeds.
